bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; requiring a report; appropriating money for the manufactured home park infrastructure grants and loans.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+TRANSFER AND APPROPRIATION; MANUFACTURED HOME PARK INFRASTRUCTURE GRANTS AND LOANS. +]

[+(a) $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are transferred from the general fund to the housing development fund. This transfer is $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2028 and each year thereafter. +]

[+(b) $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the housing development fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for the manufactured home park infrastructure grants and loans under Minnesota Statutes, section 462A.2035, subdivision 1b. +]

[+(c) By January 15 each year, the commissioner must submit a report on the use of funds in this subdivision to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees having jurisdiction over housing finance and policy. The report must include the following information: +]

[+(1) grants and loans requested and funded during the prior fiscal year, organized by ownership type of the manufactured home park, such as private, cooperative, and municipal ownership, and by county; +]

[+(2) the average amount of grants and loans awarded; +]

[+(3) the average amount of loans issued; +]

[+(4) information regarding the terms of the loans; and +]

[+(5) information about how repaid loan funds were used. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; requiring a report; appropriating money for the manufactured home park infrastructure grants and loans.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TRANSFER AND APPROPRIATION; MANUFACTURED HOME PARK INFRASTRUCTURE GRANTS AND LOANS.

(a) $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are transferred from the general fund to the housing development fund. This transfer is $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2028 and each year thereafter.

(b) $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $15,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the housing development fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for the manufactured home park infrastructure grants and loans under Minnesota Statutes, section 462A.2035, subdivision 1b.

(c) By January 15 each year, the commissioner must submit a report on the use of funds in this subdivision to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees having jurisdiction over housing finance and policy. The report must include the following information:

(1) grants and loans requested and funded during the prior fiscal year, organized by ownership type of the manufactured home park, such as private, cooperative, and municipal ownership, and by county;

(2) the average amount of grants and loans awarded;

(3) the average amount of loans issued;

(4) information regarding the terms of the loans; and

(5) information about how repaid loan funds were used.

(c) By January 15 each year, the commissioner must submit a report on the use of funds in this subdivision to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees having jurisdiction over housing finance and policy. The report must include the following information:
